later_recall: On another day ask what Mrs Binta showed the class. Invite a demonstration with a fresh small set before showing the model again.
opening_dialogue: Let's help Aishatu set up her pretend tea shop. We must count the cups.
I can't wait to open it!
Yes. We will take turns and help each other.
I'll make a neat cup record.
Make it a puzzle! Let me try before you tell me.

model.teacher: I know you're eager, Aishatu. Let's count before we open the shop.
model.reply: I'll slow down and touch each cup once!

together.teacher: A smudge is okay, Grace. Let's check your cup record.
together.reply: I'll count again and fix it. Join me!

write.teacher: Try this puzzle, John. How can a written number show a cup count?
write.reply: Don't tell me yet! Let me count first.

recall.teacher: Everyone gets a turn, Adamu. What will help you count?
recall.reply: I rushed my story and touched a cup twice. May I try again?

task_dialogue.heading: Aishatu's shop cups
task_dialogue.prompt: Help stock my toy shop. Touch each cup once. Write how many.

task_dialogue.heading: Grace checks her record
task_dialogue.prompt: A smudge! Help me count these cups. Write how many.

task_dialogue.heading: John's picture puzzle
task_dialogue.prompt: My puzzle needs a circle for each cup. Draw two circles.

task_dialogue.heading: Grace has another try
task_dialogue.prompt: My first try need not be perfect. Trace, then write.

task_dialogue.heading: John tries before a hint
task_dialogue.prompt: No hints yet! Show four fingers. Count. Write how many.

task_dialogue.heading: Adamu gets another turn
task_dialogue.prompt: I touched one cup twice. Help me try again.

participation_scope: Likes/dislikes are enacted: Aishatu wants to open her box-toy shop quickly but pauses to count; Adamu asks for fair turns; Grace corrects a smudged record; John asks for thinking time before hints. Mrs Binta responds constructively.
